outcome_evidence: The drawer starts closed (frame 0, left_ego_image). The robot approaches and closes its fingers around the upper drawer handle (frames 60–75, wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward, exposing its sides and opening (frames 88–110, image and left_ego_image). It releases the handle and withdraws (frames 111–140, wrist_image); the drawer remains visibly open through frame 171 in image and left_ego_image. No failed attempt or unintended object displacement is established.
